theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.coshSum_transpose {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.transpose.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c) + q ^ (-(2 * cellContent c))) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c) + q ^ (-(2 * cellContent c)))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.youngDiagram_eq_of_contentPowSum_eq {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (hpow : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∑ c ∈ ν.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m) :
μ = ν

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.seminormalRep_not_matRepEquiv_of_ne {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (hne : μ ≠ ν) :
¬MatRepEquiv (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hμ) (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hν)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.youngDiagram_eq_of_contentCount_eq {μ ν : YoungDiagram} (h : ∀ (d : ℤ), (diagOf μ d).card = (diagOf ν d).card) :
μ = ν

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.mem_iff_diagIndex_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) (i j : ℕ) :
(i, j) ∈ μ ↔ diagIndex (i, j) < (diagOf μ (cellContent (i, j))).card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.diagIndex_image_downward (μ : YoungDiagram) (d : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
m ∈ Finset.image diagIndex (diagOf μ d) → ∀ k ≤ m, k ∈ Finset.image diagIndex (diagOf μ d)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.mem_diagOf {μ : YoungDiagram} {d : ℤ} {c : ℕ × ℕ} :
c ∈ diagOf μ d ↔ c ∈ μ.cells ∧ cellContent c = d

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.diagOf (μ : YoungDiagram) (d : ℤ) :
Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.cell_eq_of_content_of_diagIndex {c c' : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : cellContent c = cellContent c') (hi : diagIndex c = diagIndex c') :
c = c'

def QOU.SchurWeyl.diagIndex (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.mem_iff_lt_card_of_downward {S : Finset ℕ} (hdc : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ m, k ∈ S) (k : ℕ) :
k ∈ S ↔ k < S.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.contentCount_eq_of_matRepEquiv {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (h : MatRepEquiv (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hμ) (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hν)) (d : ℤ) :
{c ∈ ν.cells | cellContent c = d}.card = {c ∈ μ.cells | cellContent c = d}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.contentCount_eq_of_contentPowSum_eq {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (hpow : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∑ c ∈ ν.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m) (d : ℤ) :
{c ∈ ν.cells | cellContent c = d}.card = {c ∈ μ.cells | cellContent c = d}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.pow_shiftedContent {μ : YoungDiagram} {n : ℕ} (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {q : K} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
(q ^ 2) ^ shiftedContent n c = q ^ (2 * cellContent c) * (q ^ 2) ^ n

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.shiftedContent_cast {μ : YoungDiagram} {n : ℕ} (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
↑(shiftedContent n c) = cellContent c + ↑n

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.shiftedContent (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.neg_le_cellContent {μ : YoungDiagram} {n : ℕ} (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) {c : ℕ × ℕ} (hc : c ∈ μ.cells) :
-↑n ≤ cellContent c

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.row_lt_card {μ : YoungDiagram} {i j : ℕ} (h : (i, j) ∈ μ) :
i < μ.cells.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.card_filter_eq_of_powSum_eq {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {sμ : Finset ι} {sν : Finset κ} {f : ι → ℕ} {g : κ → ℕ} {K : Type u_3} [Field K] [CharZero K] {t : K} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht1 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity t) (h : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ sμ, (t ^ f i) ^ m = ∑ j ∈ sν, (t ^ g j) ^ m) (d : ℕ) :
{i ∈ sμ | f i = d}.card = {j ∈ sν | g j = d}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.coeff_sum_X_pow {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Field K] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
(∑ i ∈ s, Polynomial.X ^ f i).coeff d = ↑{i ∈ s | f i = d}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.poly_eq_zero_of_eval_pow {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {t : K} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht1 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity t) (p : Polynomial K) (h : ∀ (m : ℕ), Polynomial.eval (t ^ m) p = 0) :
p = 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.pow_right_injective_of_pos_of_ne_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {t : K} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht1 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity t) :
Function.Injective fun (m : ℕ) => t ^ m

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.contentPowSum_eq_of_matRepEquiv {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (h : MatRepEquiv (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hμ) (SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hν)) (m : ℕ) :
∑ c ∈ ν.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.seminormalRep_jmPowSum {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (m : ℕ) :
(SeminormalRep.seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hN) (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), qJM K q q⁻¹ n k ^ m) = (∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c)) ^ m) • 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.seminormalRep_not_matRepEquiv_of_contentCoshSum_ne {μ ν : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hμ : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (hν : ν.cells.card = n + 1) (hne : ∑ c ∈ ν.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c) + q ^ (-(2 * cellContent c))) ≠ ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c) + q ^ (-(2 * cellContent c)))) :
